lines.text: Many learners say: I watch the actual news every day.
Better: I watch the latest news every day.
Latest! Tell me the latest news about the game.

data.wrong: I watch the actual news every day.
data.right: I watch the latest news every day.

quiz.stem: Tell me the ___ news about the game.

native.tip: Kata “aktual” berarti terbaru, tapi actual dalam bahasa Inggris berarti nyata. Untuk berita terbaru, pakai latest.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “I watch the actual news every day.” 😅 Untuk berita terbaru, pakai latest: “I watch the latest news every day.” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “latest”. Tulis satu kalimat tentang berita terbaru hari ini dengan latest. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: The word “aktual” means newest, but actual in English means real. For recent news, use latest.
en.caption: Ever say this? “I watch the actual news every day.” 😅 For recent news, use latest: “I watch the latest news every day.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
